Who I am

Currently exploring: AI tools · Python programming · Data Visualization

I'm a first-year Computer Science Engineering student at MIT Academy of Engineering, Pune — passionate about programming, AI, and creative problem solving.

My interests span web development, AI tools, data analysis, and design. I've built a Student Grade Calculator in C, worked on a Solar Irrigation System under the Zero Energy Building track, explored Python through Cisco's curriculum, and earned certifications from Oracle, Microsoft, IBM, Infosys, and Anthropic.

My goal is to keep growing as a developer who can build real-world solutions — combining logic, creativity, and technology to tackle meaningful problems.
